headline: Sanctions. Liquidation of OJSC "Processing KJ" announced in Kyrgyzstan
summary: Kyrgyzstan is liquidating OJSC Processing KJ, which was placed under UK sanctions in October. The information was posted on the Kyrgyz Stock Exchange website.
why: Sanctions can restrict a company's access to banking and payments; liquidation ends its operations, with consequences for counterparties in the region.
original_headline: Санкции. В Кыргызстане объявлено о ликвидации ОАО «Процессинг КейДжи»
